player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Wɔ wo berɛ mu, wo betumi asi 'X' anaa 'O' wɔ kwaeɛ fɛfɛɛ.
Wo di nkunim deɛ wo si nkrɔnkrɔn a ɛyɛ pɛ (X anaa O) wɔ nkrɔnkrɔn.
Wo betumi adi nkunim wɔ nkrɔnkrɔn biara.
Wo nkrɔ si wo berɛ mu wɔ '[X 4]' nhyehyɛeɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mmɔbɔ fɔm no mu nsɛe. De '[X 4]' anaa '[O 2]' fɔm no.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Ntwerɔdeɛ a enni mu: {cell}. Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛgyina 0 ne 8 ntam.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Akwantu a enni mu. Nkwammoaa {cell} no adi dwuma dada.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔmhyɛni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛn ({mark}) wɔ cell {cell}
